markets.rules_primary: If the number of Israeli Knesset elections held is exactly 1 from the next Knesset election until a new government is formed or October 27, 2030 at 11:59:59 PM ET, whichever occurs first, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
Count nationwide Knesset elections actually held, beginning with the next election after issuance. Each election counts once, including repeat elections held before a new government is formed. Scheduled or cancelled elections, local elections, and separate voting phases of the same election do not count separately.

A new government is formed when the Knesset expresses confidence in it. The count stops at the first such vote after the first counted election, or October 27, 2030 at 11:59:59 PM ET, whichever occurs first. A coalition agreement, presidential assignment, or continuation of the outgoing government does not end the count. If no new government has formed by the cutoff, count elections held through the cutoff. If no election is held, all listed markets resolve No.

Use the Central Elections Committee’s official election records and the Knesset’s official government-formation record.

Count nationwide Knesset elections actually held, beginning with the next election after issuance. Each election counts once, including repeat elections held before a new government is formed. Scheduled or cancelled elections, local elections, and separate voting phases of the same election do not count separately.

A new government is formed when the Knesset expresses confidence in it. The count stops at the first such vote after the first counted election, or October 27, 2030 at 11:59:59 PM ET, whichever occurs first. A coalition agreement, presidential assignment, or continuation of the outgoing government does not end the count. If no new government has formed by the cutoff, count elections held through the cutoff. If no election is held, all listed markets resolve No.

Use the Central Elections Committee’s official election records and the Knesset’s official government-formation record.

custom_strike.Topic: James Talarico is assigned to the Senate Committee on Health, Education, Labor, and Pensions for the 120th Congress

markets.early_close_condition: This market will close and expire early if the event occurs.
markets.rules_primary: If James Talarico is assigned to the Senate Committee on Health, Education, Labor, and Pensions for the 120th Congress after Issuance and before Mar 1, 2027, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
Being assigned to a committee refers to James Talarico being named a member of that committee for the 120th Congress, whether in a Senate resolution, on Senate.gov, or in an announcement by Senate Democratic leadership. Assignment only to a subcommittee of that committee does NOT count.

The market for a committee resolves to No once every seat allotted to Democrats on that committee for the 120th Congress has been filled by Senate resolution and James Talarico is not among the members named. A later change to that committee's membership does not reopen a market that has resolved to No.

Only reporting from the United States Senate or any other Source Agency qualifies for the purposes of this market. Reports that merely reference prior publications (from before Issuance) do not qualify. Republishing of content originally produced by other sources (e.g., wire services) only qualifies if the content is hosted on the outlet's official platform and the outlet is clearly identified as the publishing entity.

markets.early_close_condition: This market will close and expire early if the specific individual leaves the role as defined in the payout criteria.
markets.rules_primary: If Steve Scalise leaves (or announces he will leave) as U.S. Representative before Jan 1, 2027, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
This market resolves based on when the departure is publicly announced or officially communicated, regardless of the effective date.

Giving up House Majority Leader or any other leadership post alone does not count. An acknowledgement that the person will leave the role due solely to the scheduled expiration of a term does not count, including a statement that Steve Scalise will not seek another term or will run for another office when his term ends. Announcing that he will not take the seat in the 120th Congress that he won on Nov 3, 2026 does count as leaving.

If the person leaves the role due to death (i.e., if the person dies while holding the role), all contracts on the person may resolve to the last fair price as determined in the sole discretion of the Exchange. Temporary leaves of absence, suspensions, or recusals do not constitute leaving, resigning from, or retiring from the role unless the individual formally and permanently ceases to hold the position. If the person vacates the role and then re-occupies the role, the contract may settle on the initial vacation of the role.

For "leave," cessation of holding the role qualifies, including resignation, retirement, removal, expulsion, expiration of term without renewal, recall, or other means by which the individual no longer occupies the role. This includes both voluntary and involuntary early departure; a departure at the natural end of a term counts only as stated above.
markets.title: Will Steve Scalise announce their departure as U.S. Representative before Jan 1, 2027?

markets.rules_primary: If the Brazilian Senate votes to open impeachment proceedings against Alexandre de Moraes after Issuance and before Jan 1, 2027, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
Only reporting from any of the Source Agencies qualifies for the purposes of this market. Reports that merely reference prior publications (from before Issuance) do not qualify. Republishing of content originally produced by other sources (e.g., wire services) only qualifies if the content is hosted on the outlet's official platform and the outlet is clearly identified as the publishing entity.

The Brazilian Senate opens impeachment proceedings against Alexandre de Moraes when its plenary votes to approve, as admissible, an impeachment complaint (denúncia por crime de responsabilidade) against him. The Senate's officially announced result controls, whatever vote threshold it applies; a later court decision suspending or annulling an approved vote does not change the outcome.

The following do NOT satisfy the Payout Criterion:
The Senate President receiving, reading, accepting or forwarding a complaint, or declining to act on one
A vote or report by a Senate committee or special committee without plenary approval
A plenary vote that rejects the complaint or archives it
A vote in the Chamber of Deputies, a parliamentary inquiry (CPI), or an investigation or proceeding at the Supreme Federal Court

markets.early_close_condition: This market will close and expire early if the election winner is officially declared or certified.
markets.rules_primary: If the APC candidate wins the 2027 Rivers State governorship election, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
A party's candidate is the person INEC lists as that party's nominee for this election; a candidate the party substitutes under INEC rules still counts for that party. A candidate who runs under another party's name, even if backed by the party, does not count for it. If a party merges into another registered party, the successor party's candidate counts. A candidate registered under a listed party's own name counts only for that party; if a candidate would otherwise count for more than one listed party through a merger, the candidate counts only for the first of them in the order APC, NDC, ADC and PDP. APC is the All Progressives Congress, NDC the Nigeria Democratic Congress, ADC the African Democratic Congress, PDP the Peoples Democratic Party. If a second election is held, the winner is the candidate INEC finally declares elected.

This market is eligible for accelerated resolution by a consensus of media calls. See full rules for details.

markets.rules_primary: If the number of days on which Donald Trump golfs is at least 5 in Nov 2026, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
How this is resolved

Golf days from Nov 1 to Nov 30, 2026 count, including those before these markets opened.
A day counts if Roll Call Factbase's presidential calendar feed (https://media-cdn.factba.se/rss/json/trump/calendar-full.json) shows its "golf" value as true.
A day also counts if a White House pool report or a Getty Images, Reuters Connect or AP Photos image unambiguously shows Donald Trump playing golf that day.
Markets may resolve as soon as the number of days that count reaches the strike. Otherwise they resolve at expiration, 10:00 AM ET two days after the month ends (Dec 2, 2026).

markets.rules_primary: If the number of Knesset seats held by the factions in Israel's next government is at least 61 when the Knesset approves it before Oct 28, 2027 (0 if it does not), then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
Israel's next government is the first one the Knesset elected on Oct 27, 2026 approves in a vote of confidence. A faction counts if it is part of that government's coalition: it signed a coalition agreement to join the government that was submitted to the Knesset before the vote, or one of its members is a minister when the Knesset approves the government or is appointed a deputy minister within 30 days after the vote. Factions that only support the government from outside the coalition or abstain do not count, including under a written support agreement. Seats are each faction's size in the Knesset on the day of the vote; later changes do not count.

A majority government holds at least 61 of the 120 seats, and a minority government holds 1 to 60 ("between" includes both 1 and 60).

If that Knesset dissolves before approving a government, or none is approved before Oct 28, 2027, the number of seats is 0 and only No government resolves to Yes.

Israel's next government is the first one the Knesset elected on Oct 27, 2026 approves in a vote of confidence. A faction counts if it is part of that government's coalition: it signed a coalition agreement to join the government that was submitted to the Knesset before the vote, or one of its members is a minister when the Knesset approves the government or is appointed a deputy minister within 30 days after the vote. Factions that only support the government from outside the coalition or abstain do not count, including under a written support agreement. Seats are each faction's size in the Knesset on the day of the vote; later changes do not count.

A majority government holds at least 61 of the 120 seats, and a minority government holds 1 to 60 ("between" includes both 1 and 60).

If that Knesset dissolves before approving a government, or none is approved before Oct 28, 2027, the number of seats is 0 and only No government resolves to Yes.

markets.rules_primary: If the number of distinct U.S. states JD Vance has visited (per VISITAREA rules) is at least 5 in Nov 2026, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
The observation period begins at 12:00 AM ET on Nov 1, 2026 and ends before Dec 1, 2026.

For the purposes of this Contract, the count refers to distinct U.S. states visited as documented in official travel records, such as photo galleries, schedules and pool reports, released by the White House or the Office of the Vice President. A state counts once, no matter how many times it is visited. No separate official total is required: the Exchange will compile the distinct states shown in those records for the observation period, using records released before the Expiration Time.

VISITAREA contract: https://kalshi-public-docs.s3.amazonaws.com/contract_terms/VISITAREA.pdf

The following do NOT constitute a visit:

Flying over the area without landing
Layovers during which the person remains in an airplane
Virtual or remote appearances
Presence in international waters adjacent to the area
Presence solely within embassy or consulate grounds
Plans, announcements, or scheduling of future visits that do not occur during the applicable time period

For the avoidance of doubt, a visit occurs only when the person exits an aircraft, vehicle, vessel, or train within the area, or otherwise physically enters the area not aboard one. Remaining aboard, including during flyovers, drive-throughs, and non-exit refueling stops, does not constitute a visit. Exiting within the area constitutes a visit regardless of duration or method of exit.

markets.rules_primary: If Gina Hinojosa, as Governor of Texas, lifts Texas's H-1B hiring freeze early after Issuance and before Mar 1, 2027, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
Lifting the freeze means Gina Hinojosa, acting as Governor of Texas, signs an executive order or proclamation, or issues a formal written directive, that ends the requirement for covered state agencies and public institutions of higher education to obtain written permission from the Texas Workforce Commission before initiating or filing new H-1B petitions. The requirement may end through more than one such order, but it must have ended for both groups before Mar 1, 2027. A published order or directive from the Governor of Texas that has taken effect counts as the report. Pledges, case-by-case approvals, orders that take effect on or after Mar 1, 2027, ending the requirement for only some groups, and letting the directive expire on its own do NOT count.

Only reporting from the Governor of Texas qualifies for the purposes of this market. Reports that merely reference prior publications from before Issuance do not qualify unless the new report itself explicitly reaffirms the truth of the topic as of its publication date. Republishing of content originally produced by other sources (e.g., wire services) only qualifies if the content is hosted on the outlet's official platform and the outlet is clearly identified as the publishing entity.
markets.title: Will it be reported by the Governor of Texas that Gina Hinojosa, as Governor of Texas, lifts Texas's H-1B hiring freeze early before Mar 1, 2027?

markets.rules_primary: If the number of days on which Donald Trump is at Mar-a-Lago is at least 5 in Nov 2026, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
How this is resolved

Days from Nov 1 to Nov 30, 2026 on which Donald Trump is at Mar-a-Lago count, including those before these markets opened.
Any part of a day at Mar-a-Lago counts, including arriving late in the evening or leaving in the morning. Days are Eastern Time calendar days.
A day counts if a White House pool report or the White House press office reports Donald Trump at Mar-a-Lago that day. A day also counts if those reports show Donald Trump spending the night before or after it in Palm Beach, unless he stays somewhere other than Mar-a-Lago.
A day at another Trump property, including Trump International Golf Club West Palm Beach, does NOT count unless Donald Trump is also at Mar-a-Lago that day.
Markets may resolve as soon as the number of days that count reaches the strike.

markets.rules_primary: If any Montana state district court or the Montana Supreme Court holds or declares Senate Bill 542 (2025) unconstitutional and void — in its entirety or at least as to its graduated class four property tax rates — in Hertz v. State of Montana, any appeal of that action, or any other Montana action challenging Senate Bill 542's constitutionality before Mar 1, 2027, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
The ruling must:
Be issued by any Montana state district court or the Montana Supreme Court in Hertz v. State of Montana, any appeal of that action, or any other Montana action challenging Senate Bill 542's constitutionality
Address the matter described by the specified judgment
Be issued through a written order, opinion, judgment, or decision

The following do NOT satisfy the Payout Criterion:
Oral rulings from the bench unless reduced to a written order
Tentative rulings that are not made final
Draft opinions that leak but are not officially issued
Settlements or voluntary dismissals
Administrative or scheduling orders
Orders to show cause
Minute orders that do not address the substantive issue in the specified judgment

For clarity:
If the case is dismissed for lack of jurisdiction, that counts as a ruling only if the judgment refers to jurisdiction
Sua sponte rulings count if they match the specified judgment
Per curiam opinions and summary orders count as rulings
If multiple judges issue separate opinions, the majority/plurality opinion controls

markets.early_close_condition: This market will close and expire early if the visit occurs.
markets.rules_primary: If Zohran Mamdani has physically travelled to and been present within the geographic boundaries of the White House before Nov 1, 2026, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
Visits that began before market issuance do not count.

The following do NOT constitute a visit:

Flying over the area without landing
Layovers during which the person remains in an airplane
Virtual or remote appearances
Presence in international waters adjacent to the area
Presence solely within embassy or consulate grounds
Plans, announcements, or scheduling of future visits that do not occur during the applicable time period

For the avoidance of doubt, a visit occurs only when the person exits an aircraft, vehicle, vessel, or train within the area, or otherwise physically enters the area not aboard one. Remaining aboard, including during flyovers, drive-throughs, and non-exit refueling stops, does not constitute a visit. Exiting within the area constitutes a visit regardless of duration or method of exit.

The White House means any of: The Executive Residence, the West Wing, the East Wing, the Eisenhower Executive Office Building, and all gardens, lawns, and outdoor spaces within the secured perimeter of the White House, including the Rose Garden and the South Lawn.

markets.early_close_condition: This market will close and expire early if a new leader is announced.
markets.rules_primary: If Elly Schlein is announced as the first new non-interim leader of Italy's centre-left coalition before Jan 1, 2028, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
The market resolves when the first new non-interim leader is officially announced by the party or credible sources. The person need not have taken office before the deadline date, only be announced as the incoming leader. Interim or acting leaders do not qualify unless they are subsequently announced as the permanent leader. If multiple persons are simultaneously announced as co-leaders, the market resolves proportionally. Leadership contests that extend beyond the deadline date without an announcement resolve to No. The announcement must come from official party channels or be confirmed by multiple credible news sources.

For the purposes of this Contract, Italy's centre-left coalition refers to the alliance led by the Democratic Party (PD) with its partners, including the Five Star Movement (M5S) while it remains part of the alliance, and its leader refers to the first person that PD and M5S jointly name as the coalition's leader or candidate for Prime Minister, or, if M5S has left the alliance, the first person that PD and its remaining partners jointly name. M5S has left the alliance once it announces it will run outside it or files electoral lists not linked to PD's. The winner of a coalition primary held by these parties, a joint announcement by their leaders, and the name that the coalition's parties jointly declare as the proposed Prime Minister in their electoral filing each count as jointly naming.

The following do NOT count:
A party naming only its own candidate for Prime Minister
A person who leads only one party of the coalition
A candidate named by an alliance that does not include PD

If no leader is jointly named in this way before Jan 1, 2028, each market resolves to No.

custom_strike.Topic: the President of Israel gives Benjamin Netanyahu the second mandate to form a government following the 2026 Knesset election

markets.early_close_condition: This market will close and expire early if the event occurs.
markets.rules_primary: If the President of Israel gives Benjamin Netanyahu the second mandate to form a government following the 2026 Knesset election after Issuance and before Mar 1, 2027, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
Only reporting from The Times of Israel qualifies for the purposes of this market, and the report must be published after Issuance and before the date in the market title. Reports that merely reference prior publications (from before Issuance) do not qualify unless the new article itself explicitly reaffirms the truth of the topic as of its publication date. Republishing of content originally produced by other sources (e.g., wire services) only qualifies if the content is hosted on the outlet's official platform and the outlet is clearly identified as the publishing entity.

This market concerns the second formal assignment of the task of forming a government (the mandate) following the Oct 27, 2026 Knesset election. Only one assignment counts: the first formal assignment made after the first mandate (the President's initial assignment following that election), as shown by the President's office record. A report of an assignment to anyone other than the person so assigned does not qualify. An assignment under section 10 of Basic Law: The Government at the request of a majority of Knesset members counts if the President made no section 9 assignment. A section 9 referral, an extension, party recommendations, reported intentions, and expected assignments do not qualify. If the task is assigned to someone who agreed to share or rotate the premiership, only the person assigned counts.

No one resolves to Yes only if the Knesset gives confidence to a government formed under the first mandate, or is dissolved for new elections, before a second assignment. Once the assignment or that outcome is established by the record, every other market resolves to No.
markets.title: Will it be reported by The Times of Israel that the President of Israel gives Benjamin Netanyahu the second mandate to form a government following the 2026 Knesset election before Mar 1, 2027?
